correctness.rationale: Finite-state transition matrix strictly positive and even-analytic stationary spin correlations. The exact stationary KL reduces to bond-flux formula. Off-diagonal correlations at J² are pairwise common-neighbor products, diagonals exactly one; cubic zero-coupling contractions and all circumference path congruences give the closed J4 coefficient. The exact checker establishes 207 polynomial identities for L=3..25, and an independent 512-state calculation confirms finite examples. Universal L follows from a separate bounded two-step walk congruence classification, not from finite tests. No uniform volume bound claimed.
